Subject: Q2 OKR mid-quarter check — status, rescope proposals, and blocked dependencies

Team —

Quick mid-quarter check-in as we close week 1 of June. The QBR deck is due to the execs next Tuesday; I attached the QBR_prep_template.pptx (also in the drive link below). I need concise, two-slide updates per OKR from each owner by EOD Monday.

Top asks in this thread:
- Status short bullets for each active OKR you own (progress %, last major deliverable, risk level)
- Any rescope proposals (what to reduce/shift and why) with impact on downstream teams
- Blockers and required dependencies (people + ETA) — call these out explicitly so I can escalate.

Priority areas I care about for the QBR: production reliability, Dedicated capacity pilot readiness, and the Private deployment compliance checklist. We cannot have surprises in the QBR.

I will collate answers into the deck and follow up on open escalations.

Thanks —
Markus

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 OKR mid-quarter check — status, rescope proposals, and blocked dependencies

Markus —

Platform Reliability (OKR-1) update:
- Progress: 60% (on track for rollout to 25% of traffic by end of month).
- Last major deliverable: Canary runtime improvements landed (PR#4512 merged on 6/3).
- Risk: Medium. Kernel availability on a subset of older GPU nodes is causing ~9% tail latency for certain models.

Rescope proposal: Reduce the 15% overall latency improvement target to 8% for Q2 and move the remaining optimization work into Q3 focused on architecture-level changes. Rationale: kernel patching requires a coordinated infra kernel rebuild and validation window we don't have this quarter.

Dependencies/blockers:
- Need a Dedicated capacity slot for extended canary validation (3 days) — request to infra team for GPU schedule.
- Security needs the latest perf test artifacts for the Private customer audit (SOC2 evidence). I can produce artifacts by 6/12 if infra provides validated logs and test vectors by 6/9.

I will add the two-slide summary to the deck and share a screenshot by Monday.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop | Director, Platform Engineering

Subject: Re: Q2 OKR mid-quarter check — status, rescope proposals, and blocked dependencies

Quick note on the rescope ask from Lauren. I support the proposal to adjust the latency improvement target from 15% -> 8% for Q2. Given current hardware allocation timelines and our prioritization for the Dedicated pilot, we should avoid overcommitting.

Impact summary:
- Product: keeps the Dedicated pilot schedule intact but reduces risk of late regressions.
- Sales/CS: minimal customer-facing impact if we communicate the pilot scope clearly (we'll focus on stability & cost metrics rather than absolute latency).
- Finance: projected cost savings are neutral for Q2; we'll revisit in Q3.

Action I need from you, Markus: official sign-off on the rescope (so I can update the OKR and notify the org).

Also filing JIRA note: JIRA-OKR-3421 documents the rescope rationale and the acceptance criteria for the reduced target.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Head of Product Management
